rule: Expected outcomes are written before implementation. Changing an expected outcome, expected_detail or priority needs a founder-approved ADR (CLAUDE.md); attack/meta_test.go pins a digest of these fields so any change is visible in review.

outcomes.VERIFIED: A VERIFIED statement is issued (positive controls and pipeline properties).
outcomes.BLOCKED: Rejected before commit, so no effect.
outcomes.DETECTED: Committed, and a MISMATCH statement or alert was issued.
outcomes.UNVERIFIABLE: An UNVERIFIABLE statement is issued, naming the evidence gap; never MISMATCH and never VERIFIED. V7: the change committed, and the witness sealed UNVERIFIABLE naming the gap.
outcomes.OUTSIDE SCOPE: Behaviour is documented; a VERIFIED or absent statement is expected and asserted.
outcomes.NO EFFECT: Nothing committed, so no statement is expected and none may be issued.
outcomes.DENIED: The Gate refused the action before execution. A deed with decision deny is sealed; the target is unchanged.
outcomes.REJECTED: Refused at authentication or validation with a canonical error code. No action runs; the target is unchanged.
outcomes.REDACTED: The action ran or failed, and no credential value appears in any response, log line, event, deed or Console view.
outcomes.MISMATCH: The change committed; the witness sealed a MISMATCH verdict with a diff.

priorities.P0: Must pass at release gates G3/G4.
priorities.P1: Must pass by G5 or appear in LIMITATIONS.md as not yet tested.
priorities.doc-only: Documented; not an automated test in V0.

cases.expected_detail: DETECTED (the other writer's version is reported as out_of_band and isn't bound to the action; the action's verdict comes from its own transaction only)

cases.title: Another client sends a write carrying the action's X-Request-ID token
cases.expected_detail: DETECTED (the version is reported as request_id_reused and is never bound: binding needs the version the server reported to this action, so the forged version never makes the action VERIFIED)

cases.title: One create commits two resource versions in one transaction (a placeholder reference target) while the call reports one
cases.expected_detail: MISMATCH at L2 (fhir_extra_versions: the action's transaction committed 2 resource versions, the call reported 1; the extra resource is named)

cases.title: A HAPI version row stored as JSONC in a large object (pre-7.0 storage)
cases.expected_detail: UNVERIFIABLE (L2 gap large_object_not_replicated); never MISMATCH and never VERIFIED

cases.title: An update with a stale If-Match: the server answers 412 (409 on HAPI)
cases.expected_detail: NO EFFECT (fhir_version_conflict: the action is sealed as failed, isn't retried, and no version is created or claimed)

cases.title: A write to a resource type outside the connector's allowed_resource_types
cases.expected_detail: DENIED (no request leaves; a deed with decision deny is sealed; the server's history is unchanged)

cases.title: A planted patient identifier or clinical value in the request or result of a PHI-mode org's action
cases.expected_detail: REDACTED (once the action is sealed the planted values appear in no action row, deed, event, export or log line of the org; only ids and digests remain)

cases.title: A delete of a clinical resource under the healthcare-fhir pack
cases.expected_detail: DENIED (the pack's no-delete-clinical rule; no request leaves; the deed names the rule)
